correctness.rationale: An all-but-one-edge cyclic trail of the full balanced de Bruijn multigraph omits a single balanced edge, necessarily a homogeneous-loop edge. Every admissible shortened cycle therefore has only a^n missing. At a^(n-1) exactly q-1 insertion sites restore that loop; distinct positions yield distinct rotation classes as near-universal cycles are aperiodic. Only symbols in the q constant n-windows can be safely deleted, giving qn indexed positions and q distinct necklace outcomes. Double counting loop-deletion pairs gives C=qD/(q-1), where the classical D=(q!)^(q^(n-1))/q^n. The n=1 empty-state graph is included. Exhaustive independent sets confirm every assertion for q,n pairs (2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,1),(3,2),(4,1), but the proof is infinite.

originality.rationale: Existing literature explicitly contains forward puncturing of a^n, reinsertion into a^(n-1), and the count D of full cycles (Goresky-Klapper 2011, §8.2.4), as well as algorithmic one-loop cuts of constructed cycles (Cameron-Gundogan-Sawada 2022, §4.2). Those are excluded from the novelty claim. The inspected texts do not assert a converse classifying every length q^n-1 window-distinct cycle, the exact iff set of deletion positions for every arbitrary full cycle, or the unrestricted q-ary rotation-class count as the coherent result. The omitted-edge balance lemma supplies the extra necessary condition. Literature risk remains for an implicit equivalence in unindexed modified/PN sequence papers.
residual_risks: A characterization in unindexed classical pseudonoise or feedback-shift-register literature might implicitly prove all one-deficit cut-down cycles are punctured.
The image-count formula is a concise consequence of classical insertion multiplicity once the missing-edge converse is known, so priority of that converse is critical.
Published-record semantic search is not an exhaustive literature index; external scientific validation has not been performed.

value.rationale: Puncturing a universal cycle is a standard practical way to shorten an exhaustive test sequence. This theorem determines the complete codimension-one feasible class, the exact number of safe single-symbol edits independent of the cycle, and all cyclic outputs via an exact unrestricted q-ary enumeration. These are natural rigidity and robustness invariants, not a parameter-tuned finite computation; the balanced-edge obstruction explains why only homogeneous positions work.
